usedFor: AutoQuote3D is where a print shop's quotes and orders come in; Slack is where the shop floor hears about them. A “New Order” in AutoQuote3D can post to a channel with “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in AutoQuote3D, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is what the team has to act on, and you can limit the trigger to chosen statuses so only the ones that matter reach the channel.

watchOut: “New Order” and “New Quote” both poll, so the post follows a short while after. On 50agents, an automation's post to a Slack channel also waits for your approval today.
